chunks: And the Messenger of Allah, peace be upon him and his family, said:
The speech of a false witness does not end before the judge until he has taken his seat in the Hellfire, and likewise one who conceals testimony.

key_terms.الشَّهَادَةَ: testimony that ought to be given truthfully
key_terms.النَّارِ: the Hellfire as punishment in the afterlife
key_terms.الْحَاكِمِ: the judge before whom testimony is delivered
key_terms.شَاهِدِ زُورٍ: a false witness who gives untrue testimony
key_terms.يَتَبَوَّأَ: to take up or prepare for oneself a place

ai.seo_question: What does the hadith say about false witnesses and concealing testimony?
ai.summary: This hadith strongly condemns false testimony and concealing testimony in judicial settings. It shows that both acts are grave sins tied to accountability before Allah and punishment in the Hellfire.
